codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

faq.description: Quick answers about this fan-made Sephiria builds site.

items.question: What is Sephiria?
items.answer: Sephiria is an action roguelite by Team Horay, the studio behind Dungreed. You climb a tower, evolve weapons, collect artifacts and build around Miracles, costumes and stats.

items.question: Is Sephiria Builds official?
items.answer: No. Sephiria Builds is an independent fan-made community site and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Team Horay or Valve.

items.question: Which build should beginners try first?
items.answer: Start with the Sword and Shield or Greatsword family for a forgiving defense-first run. The tank Katana route is another strong option once you understand the basics.

items.question: What patch do these guides cover?
items.answer: The initial guides target the 1.0.30-era balance. Always check the game version badge and last-updated date because weapon interactions can change after patches.

items.question: How are builds ranked?
items.answer: We separate evidence from power: video clears, community clear claims, current tests and legacy retests. There is no universal best weapon; the right route depends on your playstyle.
